critique_ids: 5: remote.js/avatar.js mount no weapon model - nobody can see what class you are
6: player.js SPEEDS has no dodge; 62 m/s petals cannot be dodged at 8.6 m/s; mobility outsourced to the dash pickup in items.js
7: conditions.js is pre-round dressing; no mid-round arena moment anywhere in match.js
one_big_idea: Show the weapon, give them a Dodge Roll: mount real weapon models on remote avatars (readability) + a 0.35s dodge with 0.12s i-frames (the movement verb both weapon families need).

directives.title: Weapon on the body
directives.acceptance: In a 2-client mptest run, a Leaf Blade swap is visible as a lit blade in the remote's hand within one snapshot; veiled players show no weapon; <1ms frame regression with 8 bots.

directives.title: Dodge Roll with i-frames
directives.acceptance: Double-tap A launches ~4.5m sideways; a petal timed into the first 0.12s deals no damage; no chain-dodge inside 0.45s; works with all five tools.

directives.title: The Last Thirty (mid-round arena moment)
directives.acceptance: At 30s left the play area contracts server-authoritatively, charge regen x1.4, 4 soak/sec outside; stalemate rounds now force contact; rematch flow unchanged.

challenge_for_mikel: Does the Dodge Roll spend the same resource as the saber? Shared pool = every roll is a swing you didn't take, both families play the same mental game (my call). Free roll on a flat cooldown = faster and friendlier but a lower ceiling. Decide before the engineer starts P3-D2, because it decides whether Stamina lives on the saber or on player.js. Dare: let me see other people's weapons before you balance another number.
